crossRefs.note: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place…
They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again; but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
and Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of…
The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,
but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster…
For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

translations.web: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
translations.bsb: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
translations.kjv: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
translations.asv: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; For Jehovah upholdeth him with his hand.
